notes.title: Early access version 0.5a
notes.content:
New update was just added to the game:

[list]
    [*]New dialogue with voice acting added. I've remade most of the story dialogue in the game, and added a lot of dumb jokes and movie/games references, which someone hopefuly find funny. Main hero is now occasionally will drop one-liner after killing an enemy
    [*]You can now choose arenas for survival. Right now there is 3 arenas: village, bunker and facility. All progress and achievements shared between arenas
    [*]Enemy models are now slightly larger and their hitboxes are easier to shoot.
   [*]Crosshairs for shotgun and grenade launcher are changed and main UI ingame is slightly smaller
[/list]

Full release plans:

I am planning to exit early access in a week or two. I almost finished final level, and it wll be available right after release. I'm afraid I can't add more content to the game in EA, I need to release it finally. I will try to fix all of the small bugs I have right now, before release. Thank you.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hello guys! There was a couple of small updates added to the game today, because I am still testing out what is causing crashes, and your feedback is very important. The development of the game staggered for the couple of weeks because of these issues, and I understand that this might be a bit frustrating for you, but I need to fix this issue completely, before moving on with developing new content.

I am working on new content still, when I can and here is the WIP screenshot of final level I made so far. 

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27154491/52b8c1eef98c9439babc99374accbd916ac6b8aa.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27154491/16307d3a1f8ca8389b48ea8f9b2cc2053c76cfb5.jpg[/img][/url]

Thank you for your patience

notes.title: Early access version 0.4a
notes.content:
A huge update:


[list]
    [*]Levels 7 and 8 of campaign are added. I decided to release levels 7 an 8 together. They are shorter by length than other levels I think, but have few new fun mechanics and enemies. I hope you will like it!
    [*]Controller support. I started to implement basic controller support. You can now rebind gamepad keys in Unity start menu, and choose gamepad control scheme in control options in main menu. Please post feedback, if you use a controller and I will improve support more. Gamepad controls in menu is coming later.
    [*]Game is now requires DirectX11
[/list]
